name: Resume Summary Writer
description: Writes a 3-5 sentence professional summary section for a resume, tailored to the target role and experience level. The summary leads with the strongest differentiators and uses language aligned to the target field. Produces complete, paste-ready summary text. Use when the user wants to write or improve their resume summary, professional profile, or career summary section. Do NOT use for resume experience bullets (use resume-bullet-writer), career change resume rewrites (use career-change-resume), or LinkedIn About sections (use linkedin-summary-writer).
